resale_co.name: Certificate of Occupancy for Resale (Resale Certificate)
resale_co.issued_by: City of Elizabeth Bureau of Zoning (Office of Zoning)
resale_co.valid_for: A temporary certificate of occupancy for resale, when violations remain, may be issued for up to 90 days
requirements: Inspection by the Zoning Officer for compliance with the City code (Health and Safety, Buildings and Construction, and Land Development chapters)
Smoke and carbon monoxide certificate from Elizabeth Fire Prevention for 1 and 2 family homes (submit a copy of the original)
All outstanding construction permits and construction violation notices must be closed
Any vacant, abandoned or foreclosing property registration fees must be paid
Lead-free or lead-safe certificate for rental single-family, rental two-family and multiple dwelling units built before 1978
Owner certifies the home and other structures meet zoning and that no rubbish, debris or bulk garbage will be left before the new occupancy
List any garage, deck, fence, shed, pool or finished basement on the application

fees.label: Resale certificate, each additional unit
fees.quote: All additional units (ex: apartments start at $60 and will add $20 per unit)

fees.label: Certificate of occupancy for resale, residential or commercial use (Code Section 17.52.060)
fees.quote: For residential or commercial uses the fee shall be $60.00

fees.label: Smoke alarm, carbon monoxide alarm and fire extinguisher certificate, inspection scheduled 11 or more days after the application
fees.quote: A. A fee of $40.00 is due when an application is submitted for an inspection that is scheduled for 11 or more days.

fees.label: Inspection scheduled 5 to 10 days after the application
fees.quote: B. A fee of $75.00 is due when an application is submitted for an inspection that is scheduled for 5 to 10 days.

fees.label: Inspection scheduled 1 to 4 days after the application
fees.quote: C. A fee of $130.00 is due when an application is submitted for an inspection that is scheduled for 1 to 4 days.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Apply online with the City's Resale Certificates application (GovPilot) and pay by credit card, or pay by mail or in person at City Hall, 50 Winfield Scott Plaza, Elizabeth, NJ 07201. Attach a copy of the smoke and carbon monoxide certificate from Fire Prevention, which is applied for separately. Only affidavits on an attorney's letterhead may be attached online; notarized affidavits must be handed in as originals.
resale_co.contact_title: Zoning office staff (Zoning Board of Adjustments, Rm. 101); named as the resale certificate contact on the application

evidence.quote: A Resale Certificate is required when selling a home and is the responsibility of the seller.
No Resale Certificate will be issued on 1 & 2 family (NO INSPECTIONS FOR MONOXIDE OVER 2 FAMILIES) homes without a copy of Smoke and Carbon Monoxide Certificates.
I acknowledge all open permits must be closed prior to a certificate being issued.
Please contact vanessa.ferrara@elizabethnj.org
Before any structure for any use may be transferred, it shall be necessary for the purchaser to procure a certificate of occupancy for resale from the bureau of zoning.
Before a building or structure for any use may be sold/transferred, it shall be necessary for the purchaser to obtain a certificate of occupancy for resale from the bureau of zoning.
For one- and two-family homes: a. Smoke certificate from Elizabeth Fire Prevention.
Each additional unit shall be $20.00 per unit
Vanessa Ferrara Zoning Board of Adjustments - Rm. 101 Email Vanessa Ferrara 908-820-4096
Thomas Nicastro Zoning Officer Zoning Officer Zoning Board of Adjustments - Rm. 101 Email Thomas Nicastro 908-820-4027

resale_co.notes: City code text (Sections 15.12.860, 17.08.070 and 17.52.060, Ordinance 6013 of June 11, 2024) was read through the municode library. The ordinance says the purchaser obtains the certificate; the City's application says it is the seller's responsibility. The application lists (908) 820-4036 and (908) 820-4084 as office phones and names vanessa.ferrara@elizabethnj.org as the contact; the City directory lists her at 908-820-4096 with no title. The Zoning Officer is Thomas Nicastro, 908-820-4027, tnicastro@elizabethnj.org (City directory). Other fee rows on the form: 3 family $100.00, 4 family $120.00, commercial $60.00. Rental-only programs (landlord and rental registration, lead-safe inspections of rental units, short-term rental licenses) are not resale requirements.

requirements: Smoke alarms on each level, including basements and attics with built-up walls or gas or electric utilities, and outside each sleeping area within 10 feet of bedrooms; listed to UL 217
Carbon monoxide alarms (UL 2034) on each level and outside each sleeping area; combination smoke/CO and plug-in units are allowed
Battery smoke alarms must be 10-year sealed units; carbon monoxide alarms may not be more than 10 years old
Hardwired (AC powered) alarms must work on AC power and cannot be replaced with battery-only alarms
Fire extinguisher rated 2A-10B:C, mounted and visible within 10 feet of the stove (still listed on the City page and online form)
No security bars or gates on windows unless they have a quick-release, and only on the first floor
Illegal basement or attic tenancy, or major cooking appliances in basements or attics, will delay the certificate
Only the applicant, the realtor or the realtor's representative may accompany the inspector, not a tenant

authorities.name: Elizabeth Fire Prevention Bureau (Elizabeth Fire Department)
authorities.lead_time: Fee depends on business days between the application and the inspection date: 11 or more days for the lowest fee. Applications are taken 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. on business days. No inspection after the closing date. The certificate is good for 90 days.

fees.label: Smoke alarm, carbon monoxide alarm and fire extinguisher certificate, inspection scheduled 11 or more days after the application
fees.quote: A. A fee of $40.00 is due when an application is submitted for an inspection that is scheduled for 11 or more days.

fees.label: Inspection scheduled 5 to 10 days after the application
fees.quote: B. A fee of $75.00 is due when an application is submitted for an inspection that is scheduled for 5 to 10 days.

fees.label: Inspection scheduled 1 to 4 days after the application
fees.quote: C. A fee of $130.00 is due when an application is submitted for an inspection that is scheduled for 1 to 4 days.

authorities.how_to_apply: Apply online with the City's Smoke Detector application (GovPilot) and pay in full; the application is not processed until paid. Have the address, block and lot, expected closing date, responsible party and dwelling type ready. A failed inspection, a cancellation or a missed appointment needs a new online application and a new fee. Cancel at least 24 hours ahead; fees are non-refundable.

evidence.quote: The fee covers the initial inspection. A new application and fee is required if the initial inspection fails.

The number of days between the day of application and the day of inspection is what will be calculated. REMEMBER the day of application cannot be included with the fee timeframe scheduled. Also, REMEMBER weekends and holidays cannot be included with the fee timeframe scheduled.
If the change of occupancy specified in the (CSACMAPFEC) does not occur within 90 days, a new application and fee shall be required.
Hours of application are 9am to 3pm, not including holidays or weekends.
All battery operated smoke alarms must be 10 year seal.
Elizabeth Fire Prevention Bureau 411 Irvington Avenue Suite 301 Elizabeth NJ, 07208 Phone: 908-820-4040
No inspection will occur past the closing date.
The Elizabeth Fire Prevention Bureau is the local enforcing agency for the State Uniform Fire Safety Code.
Please feel free to contact me or the Bureau at 908-820-4040 for any questions that you may have.
Fire Extinguishers must be permanently mounted and visible within ten feet of the stove. Fire Extinguishers must be UL Listed 2-A:10-B:C and fully charged.
Dennis Guiro Fire Official Fire Official Email Dennis Guiro 908-820-2837
LEAID: 2004-001 Enf Auth. Fire Dept Fire Official Dennis Guiro Phone (908) 820-4040 Addr: 411 Irvington Ave Elizabeth NJ 07208 ... Email dennis.guiro@elizabethnj.org

fire_cert.notes: Fee tiers count days between the application and the scheduled inspection, not days before closing, and exclude the application day, weekends and holidays. Dennis Guiro's email is a mailto link in the City's Fire Prevention directory, which lists his direct line as 908-820-2837; the Bureau line is 908-820-4040. The LEA registry notes that the State enforces the fire code in County buildings in Elizabeth; that does not affect private homes. The extinguisher is still required on the City's form and page; the state dropped it from the sale certificate in February 2025 (P.L.2025, c.19), so confirm with the Bureau.

other_items.label: Open permits
other_items.detail: All open construction permits and construction violation notices must be closed before the resale certificate is issued.

other_items.label: Vacant property registration fees
